title: Mammography: masses and calcifications on CC and MLO views
description: Twelve screen-film mammograms (CBIS-DDSM, digitised film) from five women: both views (CC and MLO) of six breasts, one woman with all four views. Masses (benign and malignant, the mass outline) and calcifications (malignant and benign, the region outline) with BI-RADS assessment and pathology as the dataset gives them. Downsampled 2x2 for the web; no pixel spacing. ImageLaterality, ViewPosition and PatientOrientation are set for hanging.
